sequence.title: Freeze shared input and clock contracts
sequence.output: same sensor schema, declared periodic/speed priors, goal region, prediction field, actuator permissions and computation-time semantics; inventory remaining differences
sequence.readiness: no online actor truth; independent same-input output checks and same external acceptance; disclosing common versus method-specific modules

sequence.title: Fixed same-state RPP/MPPI software pilot
sequence.tasks: same three exposed saved inputs1/4/8; identical publicmap/causal prediction/registered path/actuator wrapper and fresh-command gate
sequence.outputs: legal command/refusal, direction/curvature/age, compute and dispatch latency; controller differences separated from shared planner failure
sequence.stopping: source/info/control/recording anomaly stops; legitimate bounded method refusal recorded

sequence.title: Small closed-loop pilot after changed interface readiness
sequence.scope: not started; requires a separately frozen bounded physical batch
sequence.tasks: first original exposed WE slot1, same shared framework for RPP and MPPI; add slots9/17 only after pilot interfaces are sound
sequence.static: reuse RPP old static pair only if exact unaffected dependency closure is proven; MPPI full static not automatically qualified by short-turn components
sequence.outcomes: safe complete nonarrival remains a failure and may continue a predeclared comparison list; safety/control/source/evidence anomalies stop the batch
sequence.repeats: pass-dependent checks are repeatability evidence, not additional independent samples
sequence.duration: conditional15–30min planning target for small pilot, not measured or guaranteed; each task retains its frozen hard cap and whole campaign a finite new root

sequence.title: Paired comparison and single-mechanism closed-loop ablations
sequence.tasks: common exposed24 task table once versions/interfaces/evaluator are frozen, followed by a genuinely unexposed table
sequence.caveat: do not directly merge old V1281 successes with new methods; first align information/actuation/clock contracts or separate tables

key_decision: Stop requiring every baseline to succeed before comparisons. Preserve V1348 valid safe failure; never call a failed software interface algorithm evidence.
